svg.text: drawn by edakit schematic draw – change the graph, not this drawing
USB tree: USB-C socket board in the stand (power only, CC resistors) -> cable W1 -> J1 (JST PH, side entry)
J1 pin 1 = VIN (5 V), pin 2 = GND; opening points down at the foot of the trunk
D32 SS34: VIN -> V_LED (about 4.6 V); blocks back-feed while the module's own USB is plugged in
V_LED: LED anodes, light chains, RGB star anode, buzzer via R41 and the module's 5V pin
C1 22 uF at the module's 5V pin, C4 22 uF at the buzzer
Full load about 0.4 A (simulated); a USB 2.0 port delivers 0.5 A
SW1 8-way DIP: A side to GND, B1-B8 directly to eight GPIOs (internal pull-ups, on = 0)
No shift register and no pull-downs (RP2350-E9: internal pull-down unreliable)
Waveshare RP2350-Zero (RP2350A) on pin headers, back of the trunk; USB-C points down
Symbol/footprint from the pin-compatible RP2040-Zero; footprint rebuilt as 23 through holes
5V pin = module VBUS (no diode on the module); 3V3 from the module's ME6217 supplies U3-U5 logic
DIP switch and buttons switch to GND, internal pull-ups (on/pressed = 0)
Module RGB LED (WS2812B) on GP16, internal: switched off at start
GP0 DIP_D4 in, pull-up, DIP switch 5 (on = 0)
GP1 DIP_D6 in, pull-up, DIP switch 7 (on = 0)
GP2 STAR_B out, PWM 1 kHz, HIGH = blue on
GP3 STAR_R out, PWM 1 kHz, HIGH = red on
GP4 BTN_MUSIC in, pull-up, music button
GP5 STAR_G out, PWM 1 kHz, HIGH = green on
GP6 DIP_D7 in, pull-up, DIP switch 8 (on = 0)
GP7 DIP_D5 in, pull-up, DIP switch 6 (on = 0)
GP8 DIP_D3 in, pull-up, DIP switch 4 (on = 0)
GP9 DIP_D2 in, pull-up, DIP switch 3 (on = 0)
GP10 DIP_D1 in, pull-up, DIP switch 2 (on = 0)
GP11 DIP_D0 in, pull-up, DIP switch 1 (on = 0)
GP12 TLC_SDO in, SPI1 RX <- U3 SDO (read-back)
GP13 BUZZER out, PWM, own slice; never static HIGH
GP15 TLC_SDI out, SPI1 TX -> U5 SDI
GP27 TLC_OE out, PWM 1 kHz, active low
GP28 TLC_LE out, latch; never HIGH while CLK runs
GP29 BTN_CONFIRM in, pull-up, confirm button
D31 RGB LED 5 mm diffuse (XL-B504RGBW), common anode at V_LED (D-48)
NPN Q2-Q4 switch the cathodes; pins 1 and 4 bent 1.6 mm (D-49)
GPIO HIGH -> NPN on -> colour on (PWM 1 kHz)
Series resistors: red 300R, green/blue 150R (about 8 mA at 4.6 V)
R37-R39 base pull-downs: dark until the firmware runs
BZ1 passive, electromagnetic, through hole: coil 42R, resonance 2.048 kHz
Q1 low-side switch, PWM from GP13 (own PWM slice)
R41 1 W through hole, value chosen when soldering: 10R full, 47R about -5 dB, 150R about -11 dB
D34 freewheels across the coil only; R36 keeps Q1 off at reset
Never leave GP13 HIGH statically (DC through the coil)
STP08CP05 constant-current sink, VDD 3V3; LED anodes at V_LED
I_OUT = 19.2 V / R-EXT = 9.6 mA (R10 = 2k) per output (datasheet table 10)
Chain: GP15 -> U5 SDI, U5 SDO -> U4 SDI, U4 SDO -> U3 SDI, U3 SDO -> GP12 (D-48)
U3 SDO -> GP12 (SPI1 RX): read-back of the 24-bit chain; CLK, LE, OE shared by U3-U5
R35 pulls OE# (active low) to 3V3: all LEDs off until the firmware runs
Light chains on OUT6/OUT7: 4 warm white 1.8 mm LEDs in parallel, each with its own resistor
Chain: U5 SDO -> U4 SDI, U4 SDO -> U3 SDI
First in the chain: GP15 -> U5 SDI
USB-C socket board (stand) -> W1 -> J1 -> D32 -> V_LED (LEDs, star, buzzer, module 5V)
Through-hole parts (LEDs, star, buzzer, R41, module) are soldered by hand and not in the BOM.
Nets with the same name are connected (labels and power flags).
Resistors 0805 1 % (R41: 1 W THT); 100 nF X7R 50 V, 22 uF X5R 25 V (0805).
Drawn by edakit schematic draw – change the graph, not this sheet.
Bare pads, not in the BOM (D-29)
TP1 VIN, TP2 3V3, TP3 V_LED, TP4 GND
